description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Mnemonic Wall
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Mnemonic Wall
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
